requirement: Desktop first-run email round: one press verifies the typed address and approves the round, only with the round's own code from Tracy's origin

oracle.invariant: The GET names Y and the match code, offers 'Email me a code', mails nothing, and is served with Referrer-Policy same-origin; so is the code step POST /signin/code answers (under no-referrer Chrome posts its form with Origin: null and every press is refused). Missing Origin, foreign Origin and another round's token are 403 and mail nothing. The web sign-in code and round 2's code are refused (401); the right code without Origin is 403; the round stays pending. The right code from Tracy answers 200 with no Approve page, sets tracy_sess for Y, the round is approved, the app's redeem is 204 with a session for Y, a second press is refused. A new code kills the previous one (401); the new one works (200).
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
